Clark County Sheriff's Office

Prosecutors in Clark County said Monday that a deputy who stabbed a suspect to death in May 2025 won’t face criminal charges.

The decision, which came three weeks after Marc Fogle’s family filed a $27 million wrongful death tort claim, could play an important role in whether the county is ultimately held liable for the killing.

Fogle was arrested after he crashed his car and was suspected of drunk driving. He was taken to an exam room by Clark County Sheriff’s Office Deputy Bryson Layton and, during an altercation, was stabbed 17 times in the back. The stabbing occurred

A 3.5 magnitude earthquake has shaken parts of Southern California Monday afternoon, striking in the Pacific Ocean off the Orange County coast and felt as far as San Diego.

The quake hit at around 1:20 p.m. The epicenter was about 18 miles southwest of Dana Point and roughly 5 miles below the surface.

Residents reported light shaking across a wide area, including Laguna Niguel, San Clemente, San Diego, El Cajon and Lynwood.

A smaller 2.8-magnitude aftershock followed the initial quake.

There was also a smaller 2.7 magnitude earthquake near Goleta in Santa Barbara County on Monday, Oct. 5.
